status: FROZEN seed hypotheses (spec section 6). Not optimized. Changes require a new version file; applies only to future decisions. v3.1.0 adds measurement/labels only; setups, forecast definition, risk and fill rules are byte-identical to v3.0.0.

data_gates.provider_disagreement_note: Preregistered engineering default: Binance USDT vs Coinbase USD latest completed 1m close. USDT/USD basis is typically <0.1%; 0.35% leaves room for basis + 1m timing noise. To be validated from stored cross-check data before any pilot evaluation.

atr.seed: SMA of first 14 true ranges (first TR uses high-low)

forecast.definition: Return r = close of 11:59 Toronto 1m candle / open of 06:00 Toronto 1m candle - 1, primary provider (binance_spot) per market. UP if r > +0.5%, DOWN if r < -0.5%, else RANGE. Equivalent on native 1h candles: open of 06:00 bar, close of 11:00 bar.
forecast.eligible_session_rule: All six native 1h primary candles 06:00-11:00 Toronto present for the session date, session date strictly before the target date.

risk.collateral_note: Jupiter minimum new-position collateral $10 (jup CLI docs). Cap $25 keeps quotes under the ~$38 SOL balance of the public quote wallet.

fills.entry_rule: open of first primary 1m candle starting at or after decision commit time + latency, adverse slippage applied
fills.stop_rule: first 1m bar touching stop; fill at min(stop, bar open) for longs (max for shorts) with adverse slippage; stop-first if stop and target in same bar (flag AMBIGUOUS)
fills.target_rule: fill exactly at target, no improvement
fills.noon_rule: open of the 12:00 Toronto primary 1m candle with adverse slippage
fills.missing_data_rule: gap in 1m sequence -> UNRESOLVED until repaired

costs.experiment_label: generic perpetual proxy priced with Binance spot; Jupiter quote costs attached. Not venue-ready performance.

trend.rule: latest completed 1h close vs EMA50 and EMA50 slope (EMA50 minus EMA50 3 completed hourly bars earlier): TREND_UP if close>EMA and slope>0; TREND_DOWN if close<EMA and slope<0; else RANGE

volatility.rule: percentile rank of current ATR14(15m) among the previous trailing_bars ATR14 values (strictly earlier, completed bars); HIGH_VOL if rank>=50, else LOW_VOL; UNAVAILABLE if fewer than trailing_bars values

r_multiple.R_definition: initial planned loss in USD at decision time (risk.planned_loss total at the quoted notional: stop distance + adverse slippage + open costs + stressed close costs + stressed financing). net_R = net PnL after all costs / R.

excursions.rule: MAE/MFE from post-entry primary 1m bars only, starting with the entry bar (entry at its open). In the exit bar only the exit price counts (intrabar order unknown). NOON exits: exit bar excluded (exit at its open).

measurement.cost_sensitivity_rule: net_k = gross - k*(fees) - k*(financing) - (k-1)*(slippage already embedded in fills). fees = open/close fee, impact, network, collateral conversion.

bootstrap.method: block bootstrap by Toronto session date

measurement.whale_lean: null unless a reproducible timestamped feed with address-selection rule exists (none as of v3.1.0)

hypothetical_skips.rule: every SKIP decision on a triggered signal gets a prospective hypothetical committed atomically with the decision; same fill simulator; modeled costs (no quote); notional = modeled sizing notional, or $20 standardized if sizing failed (flagged)
